description: The name of the pre-bridge global the editor.html ES5 capability preflight publishes its verdict on (window.__futoEngineUnsupported) and the Android host's probe program that reads it (EditorEngineSupport.kt ENGINE_PROBE_JS). Deliberately NOT part of the versioned futoBridge contract: the preflight has to work in exactly the case where the ES2020 bundle that owns bridge.ts failed to parse, and a bridge message would bump BRIDGE_VERSION and oblige both native hosts (M10) for a verdict only Android reads. A source-scan unit test holds the two spellings together.
